gen/u4_envelope_on_back.png.change: one large closed white envelope with a few black ink blots has fallen from above and now lies on the main character's back and the back of its head, as big as half of the main character; under its weight the main character is pressed even flatter into the floor, its eyes are squeezed shut, its cheeks squashed outward, its ears pushed flat; two small puffs of grey dust rise from the floor on both sides of it; the small envelope far in the background is gone; the flame on the tip of its tail is a tiny dim ember with a thin wisp of grey smoke.
